violations.text: Establishment does not have a handsink in the food prep area/ barista area. Previous handsinks were removed. A handwashing sink shall be located: (A) To allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and warewashing areas. Establishment is currently using food prep sink as a handsink. New Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2026

Establishment does not have a handsink in the outdoor bar area. A handwashing sink shall be located: (A) To allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and warewashing areas. Establishment to cease the service of blended drinks and manually composed beverages in this area at this time. Commercially pre-packaged beverages are only permitted in this area at this time. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

Frozen spinach was observed thawing on the counter. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026
1 door reach-in in kitchen was observed in poor repair. Unit was out of service prior to inspection. Equipment to be in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Establishment does not have a 3 bay sink in the outdoor bar area. A sink with at least 3 compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and sanitizing equipment and utensils. Sink compartments shall be large enough to accommodate immersion of the largest equipment and utensils. Establishment to cease the service of blended drinks and manually composed beverages in this area at this time. Commercially pre-packaged beverages are only permitted in this area at this time. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the icemachine have an accumulation of pink and black residue. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2025
Handsinks in the restrooms were lacking notification signage. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of black residue. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2025
An air gap is lacking on the food prep sink. New Violation. Correct By: 08/30/2025
The doors to the toilet rooms are not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2025

The 1 door North American refrigerator was observed held at 55-60 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. -Staff voluntarily disposed of foods above 41 degrees F. during this inspection. -Establishment shall not store TCS foods in the 1 door North American refrigerator until it is able to consistently maintain an ambient temperature of 41 degrees F. or below. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2023
